en: A vintage multi-view postcard with five illustrated scenes framed separately. The central image shows a tall brick lookout tower on a hill labeled "Rochlitzer Berg. Friedrich-August-Turm." The upper left image depicts a hilltop castle above a forested slope titled "Schloss Rochsburg." The lower left image shows a riverside scene with a large church or castle complex with two towers, labeled "Schloss Rochlitz." The upper right image shows a large brick railway viaduct over a valley, labeled "Göhrener Brücke." The lower right image depicts a complex with a castle-like building and a church tower among trees, labeled "Schloß u. Kirche Wechselburg." The style and coloring resemble early 20th‑century German postcards.
